title: Proper constant base change degree one
statement: Proper constant base change degree one.

proof.text: Replace the base-field map by an algebra map using Spec.map_surjective. Split on whether (r : k) is zero; prove the constant module sheaf and its identity pullback are annihilated by r.

When r is invertible in k, apply prime-injective cohomology comparison to the standard pullback. Its degree-zero and positive-degree hypotheses are supplied by algebraically closed extension module sections and injective acyclicity. Transport bijectivity to the supplied pullback square using the restriction-square equivalences.

When (r : k)=0, use the Artin--Schreier fixed-point model for the degree-one comparison. The semilinear Frobenius tensor fixed-point map is bijective; Finsupp.mapRange transports this coordinatewise bijection, and the model compatibility yields injectivity and surjectivity of the original map.

proof_origin.place: characteristic split; prime-injective comparison and Artin--Schreier fixed-point model
